statusText: Mapped policy state: WATCH. NQ is near its session low while rates-and-oil stress remains extreme, but a persistent no-retracement path is not yet verified.
recommendation: Mapped policy state: WATCH; Tail remains below the block threshold pending evidence of repeated extension or failed retracements, with CPI the next major path checkpoint.
headline: NQ near session low as oil-and-yield stress stays extreme ahead of CPI
body: Investing.com showed Sep NQ at 29,375.50, about 16 points above the session low and roughly 86 below the open. Reuters reported 10-year yields near 5% and Brent still above $100; fresh Finviz context showed prior-session semiconductor weakness while delayed futures were mixed.

lookbackSummary: Tail reached elevated around the September 10 PPI/cash-open window, then returned to WATCH as persistent one-way NQ structure was not retained. Stress remained extreme overnight into September 11.
outlookSummary: NQ is near its session low but has not yet established a persistent no-retracement path. Extreme rates-and-energy stress keeps the environment difficult; the main conditional danger window is 12:15-14:30 UTC around CPI, the cash open and Michigan.

forecast.analysis: Investing.com showed Sep NQ at 29,375.50, about 16 points above the 29,359.25 session low and roughly 86 below the open. Near-low placement raises Tail within WATCH, but a persistent no-retracement path is not yet established.
drivers: NQ near session low but decline remains modest
Fresh Finviz context shows weak prior-session semiconductors

forecast.analysis: First full European cash hour: Tail stays WATCH if NQ develops meaningful counter-moves. Renewed extension while holding the session low would strengthen one-way-path evidence.
European follow-through remains a structure test. Two-sided trade or a deeper rebound would keep Tail below the block threshold; repeated downside extension would raise it.
Pre-CPI positioning may thin liquidity and amplify swings. Tail remains WATCH unless NQ holds a directional extreme through shallow pullbacks before the release.
U.S. premarket sensitivity rises as CPI approaches. Oil and yields keep Stress extreme, while Tail escalation still requires sustained NQ directional efficiency rather than event importance alone.
Final pre-CPI hour: the release outcome and subsequent path are still unobserved. Stress is extreme, but Tail stays WATCH unless pre-release price action itself becomes persistently one-way.
drivers: Pre-release path remains the only observed Tail evidence

forecast.analysis: CPI is scheduled for 12:30 UTC. Tail remains WATCH before the print; after release, failed pullbacks or repeated extension would justify escalation, while orderly retracement would not.
Post-CPI into the 13:30 UTC cash open, Tail is conditionally elevated only if NQ extends repeatedly, holds an extreme, or fails its first meaningful retracement.
The first full cash hour includes Michigan at 14:00 UTC. Elevated Tail requires opening-auction continuation or another failed retracement; a sustained reversal would invalidate the higher state.
One hour after the cash open, Tail stays elevated only if session extremes continue to hold or a retracement fails into another directional leg. Mean reversion lowers the path risk.
The European close can transmit a delayed second leg if rates and NQ remain directionally aligned. Stabilization, deeper pullbacks, or cross-asset divergence would lower Tail.
By U.S. midday, WATCH is the base case if price discovery becomes two-sided. Fresh one-way extension without meaningful pullbacks would invalidate that normalization.
Midday Tail eases if NQ consolidates or retraces, even if oil and yields keep Stress elevated. A renewed break with shallow pullbacks would reverse the normalization.
Power-hour Tail is conditionally elevated only if an earlier event-driven move re-accelerates and retracements fail. Time of day alone does not establish a blocking path.
drivers: Earlier move must retain directional efficiency

forecast.analysis: Near the U.S. cash close, Tail returns to WATCH unless the closing auction reinforces a persistent one-way move or holds NQ at a directional extreme.
After the Friday NQ futures close, no new live path can form. WATCH reflects unresolved weekend gap and geopolitical risk rather than observed continuation.
NQ is closed for the weekend. No new retracement or extension evidence can form, so Tail reflects latent reopening risk rather than a live directional path.
drivers: Weekend closure; no live NQ path

forecast.analysis: Closed-market conditions prevent fresh NQ confirmation. WATCH persists because unresolved energy and geopolitical shocks could transmit at the next reopen.
drivers: Weekend energy and geopolitical gap risk

forecast.analysis: NQ remains closed. Tail is a latent reopening-risk estimate; without new verified shocks there is no fresh directional evidence supporting a higher band.
Closed-market interval: no fresh NQ path is observable. WATCH persists because unresolved macro and geopolitical stress can reprice at the next session.
Weekend Tail stays WATCH. Escalation would require a newly verified geopolitical, policy, or market discontinuity before the next NQ session.
drivers: New verified shock required for escalation

forecast.analysis: NQ is closed, so no hourly mean-reversion test is possible. Friday structure is not treated as current evidence during the weekend.
drivers: No mean-reversion test while NQ is closed

forecast.analysis: Closed-market Tail stays WATCH as a conservative latent-risk estimate. A higher state would require a new verified shock rather than extrapolation from Friday.
No live NQ path is available. WATCH reflects unresolved macro and geopolitical exposure, while confidence decays as the gap from live price evidence lengthens.
drivers: Confidence decays without new price data
